definitions: Simeon-Denis Poisson (1781-1840), a French mathematician and physicist.

A statistical distribution expressing the probability of a given number of events occurring in a fixed interval of time or space if these events occur with a known constant mean rate and independently of the time since the last event.
examples: Poisson's work on definite integrals is notable.
The number of calls received per hour often follows a Poisson distribution.
